mostWorthwhile.text: Adding valves was most worthwhile: the squeeze and refill panels made their role in directing blood flow clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the circuit's named slots was straightforward and a little repetitive, though it made the final assembly clear.

surprise.text: I was interested that red blood cells make ATP from sugar despite having no mitochondria, unlike the muscle cells described earlier.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how the circulation connects with other systems, since the final picture links the circuit to tissue needs.
